description: Post-process an existing PNG image into a clean sprite. Handles background removal, auto-crop, square padding, and sprite sheet splitting. Use this for images from external sources that need processing.

inputPath.description: Path to the input PNG file

outputPath.description: Output path. For split mode: prefix for frame files (e.g. "assets/snake" → "assets/snake-head.png")

split.description: Split sprite sheet into individual sprites by detecting content boundaries

name: process_sprite
